source.title: Show HN: Deliberate – log what your agent rejected, not just what it ran

new_capability_candidates.short_description: Show HN: Deliberate – log what your agent rejected, not just what it ran (for LangGraph and OpenAI Agents in prod)
new_capability_candidates.direct_evidence: I'm building Deliberate in response to real prod incidents... Trace tools show you what ran. I wanted something that shows you what the agent was choosing between. Early access for teams running LangGraph or OpenAI Agents in prod. (HN Show HN, 4 points, 1 comment, May 31 2026)

maps_to_codebase: openhands_skills/langgraph_orchestrator.py (our supervisor already has rich state and research injection — adding 'rejected alternatives' logging would be natural)
openhands_skills/evaluation_harness.py (we already do pre/post measurement; rejected paths are related to better scoring)
openhands_skills/research_agent.py (we could log what research ideas were considered but not turned into proposals)
fit_analysis.value_add_for_general_professional_helpe: The core idea (not just 'what the agent did' but 'what options it considered and why it rejected the others') is powerful for debugging, trust, and improving the reflection/meta layer of any agent system — including ours.
fit_analysis.suggested_as_new_skill_or_enhancement: Small enhancement in the supervisor or a new lightweight 'decision_trace' helper that records alternatives considered at key nodes (especially before guarded proposals or meta decisions). Surface it in research context and evaluation reports.
fit_analysis.integration_effort: Low. Mostly adding structured logging of rejected branches at a few decision points.
fit_analysis.evidence_to_use_in_proposal_rationale: Show HN Deliberate: response to real incidents where trace only showed what ran, not what the agent chose against. Targeted at LangGraph users in prod.

advantages: Directly addresses a real pain point (prod incidents where you only see the bad path the agent took, not the alternatives it considered). High practical value.
Explicitly calls out LangGraph users — perfect topical match for our primary orchestrator.
Comes from someone who experienced real incidents (PocketOS, DataTalks.Club) — grounded, not theoretical.
Fits beautifully with our existing emphasis on 100% evidence, pre/post eval, and meta reflection.
100% fidelity: exact Show HN url + story text excerpt + points as raw facts.
disadvantages: Relatively low points (4) + very new (May 31) — still early, limited validation signal compared to 2000+ star projects.
The actual tool is 'early access' / not fully open in the hit; more investigation required.
Requires guarded change if we decide to instrument our graph nodes with rejected-choice logging.
Adoption still goes through the full human + eval gate.
pros_cons.note: Derived ONLY from this candidate's own raw signals... Visit https://www.deliberate.dev/ and the HN thread for full context.

suggested_apply_data.old_string_hint: Around _meta_supervise, the points where we decide which research ideas become proposals, or inside _execute_engineering when building guarded payloads.
suggested_apply_data.new_string_hint: At important branch points (especially before human gate or proposal creation), record not only the chosen path but the main alternatives that were considered and why they were deprioritized. Use similar structure to our existing research_lab_idea storage.
